# Peregrine IT Solutions

> Peregrine IT Solutions is a software engineering firm that designs, builds and scales SaaS products, API integrations, automation and cloud infrastructure. Most of our clients are B2B companies in the United States and Canada, with a strong focus on real estate and proptech (brokerages, MLS/IDX data, investor platforms) and SaaS businesses.

Engineers work directly with client teams in sprint-based delivery, with daily overlap with North American business hours.

## How engagements start

- Every project starts with a 30-minute technical discovery call with an engineer, not a salesperson.
- Larger builds begin with a discovery sprint (requirements, architecture, written technical plan); development runs in two-week sprints with weekly demos.
- Small, well-defined tasks get a scoped estimate through the quick project form. Enquiries get a reply within 1 business day.
- Engagement model: fixed-scope projects, monthly retainers, or a combination, agreed after the discovery call. Pricing is scoped per project; no price list is published.
- IP ownership: once the work is paid for, the client owns the IP rights to what Peregrine builds.
- A typical SaaS MVP ships in 4 to 6 weeks; complex platforms take 8 to 12 weeks.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://peregrine-it.com/#faq): how engagements start, location and hours, industries, existing codebases, cost, timelines and past work
- [Home](https://peregrine-it.com/): what Peregrine builds, the services, selected work and the FAQ in one page
- [Guides index](https://peregrine-it.com/blog): every guide below, grouped by topic

## Services

Each service page opens with an "At a glance" table and answers, in order: what the service includes, how long a project takes, what it costs, how it starts, and which case studies show it.

- [SaaS development](https://peregrine-it.com/services/saas-development): multi-tenant platforms, billing and role-based access, from a new build to scaling an existing MVP
- [API integration](https://peregrine-it.com/services/api-integration): integration layers for CRMs, ERPs, payroll, e-signature and carrier APIs, with retries and reconciliation
- [MLS & IDX integration](https://peregrine-it.com/services/mls-idx-integration): RESO Web API and RETS feeds, multi-MLS normalization and IDX search
- [AI automation](https://peregrine-it.com/services/ai-automation): natural-language search, lead qualification assistants, document extraction and predictive models
- [AI app to production](https://peregrine-it.com/services/ai-app-to-production): review, fix, secure and deploy an app built with Lovable, Cursor, Replit, Bolt, Claude Code or v0, keeping what works and rebuilding only where justified
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://peregrine-it.com/services/cloud-devops): AWS architecture, CI/CD, caching and CDN, load testing and monitoring
- [PHP upgrade & migration](https://peregrine-it.com/services/php-upgrade-migration): security patch assessments, compatibility reviews and staged upgrades of legacy PHP, Laravel and WordPress applications to a supported PHP version, plus ongoing maintenance (no published PHP case study yet)
- [Investor portal development](https://peregrine-it.com/services/investor-portal-development): role-based investor portals with watermarked documents, capital calls and distribution reporting (one published case study)
- [Odoo ERP](https://peregrine-it.com/services/odoo-erp): Odoo HR, CRM, Inventory and Accounting implementation, custom modules, data migration and integrations
- [White-label development for agencies](https://peregrine-it.com/services/white-label-development): custom software built for agencies to deliver under their own brand (web and mobile apps, SaaS, integrations, e-commerce, modernization); not a reseller program
- [Hire Laravel developers](https://peregrine-it.com/services/hire-laravel-developers): Laravel engineering for SaaS backends, APIs, integrations and ongoing development of existing applications, as fixed-scope projects, monthly retainers or a combination (no published Laravel case study yet)
- [Hire PHP developers](https://peregrine-it.com/services/hire-php-developers): PHP engineering for legacy applications, maintenance, modernization and migrations to a supported PHP version, plus new custom PHP work (no published PHP case study yet)
- [All services](https://peregrine-it.com/services)

## Guides

- [MLS and IDX cost per month and per year (2026)](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-idx-integration-cost): cost-at-a-glance table, IDX vendor subscriptions, MLS data license fees, RESO Web API vendors and development cost drivers, with sourced figures
- [MLS and IDX cost calculator](https://peregrine-it.com/tools/mls-idx-cost-calculator): adds up published MLS license, IDX plugin and RESO Web API vendor fees per month and per year; every figure sourced; no Peregrine prices
- [Custom SaaS vs off-the-shelf CRM for brokerages](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/custom-saas-vs-off-the-shelf-crm-for-brokerages): published CRM pricing and when a custom platform makes sense
- [Cost to build a real estate platform](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/cost-to-build-a-real-estate-platform): labor rates in the US, Canada and India, MLS data, maps and hosting costs
- [How to get MLS data access for your app](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/how-to-get-mls-data-access): license types, broker sponsorship, agreements, MLS Grid / Trestle / Bridge, fees and compliance rules, with sources
- [RESO Web API vs RETS: what changes and how to migrate](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/reso-web-api-vs-rets): authentication, queries, field names, media and sync compared; platform limits for MLS Grid and Trestle; published RETS shutdown dates; a migration checklist
- [MLS data access in Canada: CREA DDF and board feeds](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-data-access-canada): DDF channels, rules, API and published technology-provider fees (CAD); PropTx, BC Reciprocity, Victoria and Pillar 9 programs; aggregators with Canadian coverage
- [IDX vendor or custom build: when to switch](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/idx-vendor-vs-custom-build): IDX plugin vs data vendor API vs direct MLS feeds, signs it is time to build, and what changes in cost, with sourced figures
- [Self-storage management software: build or buy?](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/self-storage-software-build-vs-buy): what ten products list on their own sites (pricing, APIs, access-control integrations), where multi-site operators hit limits, and three options: standardize, extend through an API, or build
- [Self-storage access control integration: keeping gates, smart locks and billing in sync](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/self-storage-access-control-integration): who owns tenant status, integration models (native, cloud events, bridge apps, scheduled sync, your own bridge), move-in, move-out and lockout states, mixed lock vendors, reconciliation and vendor questions
- [Migrating self-storage software after acquiring facilities](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/self-storage-software-migration): facility inventory, questions for outgoing vendors, mapping units, tenants, balances, paid-through dates and delinquency state, moving stored payment methods through the processors, gate codes and lock assignments, a pilot facility, cutover, reconciliation, rollback and the first billing cycle
- [Odoo implementation cost](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/odoo-implementation-cost): Odoo plans and what the Custom plan is needed for (external API, custom modules), Odoo.sh hosting prices, Success Pack prices, and the cost of maintaining custom code through upgrades, from Odoo's own pages
- [Odoo integration with Shopify and marketplaces](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/odoo-shopify-marketplace-integration): what Odoo's own Shopify Connector syncs and how often, a record-ownership table (products, stock, prices, orders, customers, fulfilment, refunds, tax), webhooks plus polling, idempotency and replay, documented rate limits and API version schedules on both sides, unit, tax and currency mapping, failure modes with detection signals and a go-live checklist; neutral guidance from Odoo and Shopify documentation, no Peregrine project claims
- [MLS data pipeline architecture](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-data-pipeline-architecture): a nine-stage reference design for ingesting MLS data through the RESO Web API, with a diagram: connector and rate limits, initial and incremental replication, removals, media, Data Dictionary normalization, duplicate linking, compliance checkpoints, and a table of failure modes with how to detect each
- [Laravel upgrade and modernization checklist](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/laravel-upgrade-checklist): Laravel and PHP support windows as published on October 10, 2026, a decision table (upgrade in place, replace in stages, rewrite) and a phase-by-phase checklist from the official upgrade guides; neutral guidance, no Peregrine project claims
- [PHP2Shell in 2026: vulnerabilities, patched versions and what website owners should do](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/php2shell-php-security-vulnerabilities-2026): the two PHP vulnerabilities fixed on October 21, 2026 (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), a patched-versions table with notes on vendor backports and PHP 8.1 and older, what WordPress and Laravel owners should check, a response checklist split by who can do it, the separate CVE-2026-115560 session issue and PHP support dates; from php.net, the GitHub advisories and CISA, NCSC and Canadian Centre alerts, no exploit detail and no Peregrine project claims
- [PHP 8.2 end of life: what to upgrade before December 31, 2026](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/php-8-2-end-of-life-upgrade-guide): PHP 8.2 security support ends December 31, 2026; a support timeline for PHP 8.2 to 8.5, a decision matrix for choosing 8.3, 8.4 or 8.5, what end of life does and does not mean, a ten-step migration checklist, Laravel and WordPress compatibility notes, options for PHP 5 and 7 systems and what drives upgrade scope; from php.net, Laravel and WordPress documentation, no prices and no Peregrine project claims
- [Investor portal vs file sharing](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/investor-portal-vs-file-sharing): what shared folders cover, where they stop (audit trails, watermarking, per-investor data) and published investor-portal prices, with sources
- [Investor portal security design checklist](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/investor-portal-security-checklist): access model by role and entity, a threat-to-control table mapped to OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 requirement numbers, the OWASP Top 10:2025 and NIST SP 800-63B-4, authentication and session settings, audit-trail fields, e-signature and capital-call controls, vendor and counsel questions, and acceptance tests; a design checklist, not a certification or legal advice
- [Engineering requirements for a production-ready IDX platform](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/idx-website-features-checklist): 25 testable requirements in five groups (architecture and data ownership, data reliability, security, performance, production operations), each with a verification method, sourced from RESO, MLS Grid, Trestle, web.dev, Google, OWASP, PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch documentation, plus questions for the MLS agreement and a requirements table for acceptance testing; not a features list, vendor ranking or cost guide
- [15 US MLS boards: a data access reference](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-boards-compared): reference profiles of 15 US MLSs in alphabetical order (not a ranking): who each serves, how data is delivered, feed types named, who may license, where the application starts and the published fees, each fact sourced from the MLS's own site
- [Tech stack for a real estate platform](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/real-estate-platform-tech-stack): how to choose the database, search engine, cache, backend language, frontend rendering, media storage and hosting for listing data, with a "choose X when" table per layer and a stack worksheet, from each technology's own documentation
- [SEO, AEO and GEO for real estate websites](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/real-estate-website-seo-aeo-geo): what a listing site has to build to be found in search, answer features and AI answers: indexable listing pages, listing lifecycle and HTTP status, sitemaps, structured data and which rich results Google supports, AI crawler controls, and sales claims to be skeptical of, from primary documentation
- [Building a Scalable MLS Synchronization Engine](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-sync-engine): How to build an MLS sync engine: full import, incremental sync, checkpoints, queues, rate limits, backoff, idempotent writes, monitoring and failure recovery; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Handling Deleted, Expired and Sold Listings Correctly](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/listing-lifecycle-sold-expired-deleted): How to handle sold, expired, withdrawn and deleted MLS listings: status mapping, removal signals, reconciliation, index cleanup, HTTP status and license rules; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [MLS Data Normalization Across Multiple Real Estate Boards](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/mls-data-normalization): How to normalize MLS data from several boards: RESO field mapping, identifiers, property types, units, media, display flags, provenance and a canonical schema; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Data Migration Strategies for Legacy Real Estate Platforms](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/legacy-real-estate-platform-data-migration): How to migrate a legacy real estate platform: what to move or re-fetch, cutover strategies, validation, URL redirects, rollback planning and a cutover runbook; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Designing a Real Estate Search Engine with Elasticsearch](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/real-estate-search-elasticsearch): Designing listing search on Elasticsearch: mappings, filters, geo queries, autocomplete, pagination, facet counts, relevance and zero-downtime reindexing; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Building Map-Based Property Search with Geospatial Queries](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/map-based-property-search): How to build map search for listings: viewport and polygon queries, spatial indexes, clustering, list and map sync, URL state, mobile and address display; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Designing Reliable Saved Searches and Listing Alerts](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/saved-searches-listing-alerts): How to build saved searches and listing alerts that do not miss, duplicate or misfire: storage, matching, dedupe, scheduling, unsubscribe and delivery; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Real Estate Website Performance: Optimizing Listing Pages for Core Web Vitals](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/listing-page-core-web-vitals): How to build listing, search and area pages that meet Core Web Vitals: rendering, the hero photo, galleries, maps, third-party scripts, caching and INP; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Building a Multi-Tenant Real Estate SaaS Platform](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/multi-tenant-real-estate-saas): How to design tenancy for a real estate SaaS: tenant hierarchy, data isolation with row-level security, custom domains, per-tenant MLS licenses and lifecycle; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Real Estate CRM Architecture: From Property Enquiry to Lead Management](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/real-estate-crm-architecture): How to design a real estate CRM: enquiry capture, attribution, deduplication, lead routing, an event timeline, consent records and integration boundaries; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [IDX CRM Integration: Sending Website Leads to Follow Up Boss, HubSpot and GoHighLevel](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/idx-crm-integration): each CRM's documented intake path for IDX website leads (Follow Up Boss Events API, HubSpot's non-HubSpot forms tool and Submit data to a form API, HighLevel Inbound Webhook trigger and Upsert Contact API), credentials, duplicate handling, error responses and a design checklist; from the vendors' own documentation, no Peregrine project claims
- [Building Reliable Webhook and Event-Driven Integrations](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/webhook-event-driven-integrations): How to receive and send webhooks reliably: signature checks, idempotency, ordering, retries with jitter, the outbox pattern, reconciliation and SSRF defenses; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Designing Reliable Background Jobs with Redis and BullMQ](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/background-jobs-redis-bullmq): How to run BullMQ on Redis in production: retries and backoff, concurrency, stalled jobs, idempotent handlers, Job Schedulers, Redis settings and failure modes; engineering guidance with illustrative examples and primary sources, no Peregrine project claims beyond its published case studies
- [Vibe-Coded App Security Checklist: What to Check Before Launch](https://peregrine-it.com/blog/vibe-coded-app-security-checklist): What to check before an AI-built app takes real users and data: authentication, server-side authorization, Supabase row-level security, secrets, webhooks, backups, monitoring and CI/CD, each with a safe self-check; defensive guidance with official documentation as sources, no Peregrine project claims

## Case studies

All twenty, in the order they appear on the hub. Each case study opens with a "Results at a glance" table: client, industry, stack, project duration and three headline results, or "No outcomes published" where none are published.

- [Scaling a real estate SaaS platform](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/scaling-real-estate-saas-platform): re-architected a US/Canada property search product to serve millions of MLS listings with sub-second search.
- [AI-powered multi-market real estate platform](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/w3re-ai-real-estate-platform): unified four MLS feeds for a brokerage and added natural-language search, automated valuation and an AI lead-qualification assistant.
- [Investor portal for a real estate developer](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/proptech-investor-portal): role-based portal with document management, capital call workflows and automated distribution reporting.
- [Supply chain visibility platform](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/supply-chain-visibility-platform): normalized tracking data from 12 carrier APIs with ETA prediction and exception alerts.
- [Self-storage management SaaS](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/self-storage-management-platform): operator platform with smart-lock integration, automated billing and live occupancy dashboards.
- [Engineering RealFoyer](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/realfoyer): how we engineered our own real estate SaaS (not a client project): one shared database with a tenant key per site resolved by hostname, MLS feeds per board activated per agent after board approval, search, CRM and CMS; no outcomes published.
- [Real-Time Fleet Tracking Platform for a Regional Logistics Company](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/logistics-fleet-tracking-platform): a GPS fleet management system with live tracking, route optimization, driver apps and customer ETA alerts for 500+ vehicles in the MENA region.
- [Unified Clinic Management System for a Multi-Location Healthcare Network](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/multi-location-clinic-management): a HIPAA-compliant practice management platform unifying patient records, telehealth, scheduling and insurance billing across 35 clinics.
- [Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Marketplace with Split Payments & Bilingual UX](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/multi-vendor-ecommerce-marketplace): a bilingual Arabic/English marketplace for 400+ Gulf vendors with automated split payments, vendor onboarding and real-time inventory sync.
- [EdTech Learning Platform with LMS & Video Streaming](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/edtech-learning-platform): a custom EdTech LMS with HLS video streaming and course management, serving 12K+ enrollments across 500+ courses at 99.2% uptime.
- [Food Delivery Aggregator for Multi-Restaurant Marketplace](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/food-delivery-aggregator-platform): a multi-restaurant food delivery platform with 200+ restaurants, 50K+ orders a month and real-time driver dispatch.
- [HR & Payroll SaaS for Mid-Market Companies](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/hr-payroll-saas-platform): an HR and payroll SaaS for 85+ mid-market companies and 12K employees, with multi-state tax, benefits integration and 99.9% payroll accuracy.
- [Insurance Claims Automation for Claims Processing](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/insurance-claims-automation-platform): a claims automation platform processing 45K+ claims a year, with document extraction, multi-carrier rules and a full audit trail.
- [Restaurant POS & Online Ordering for QSR Chains](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/restaurant-pos-ordering-system): a POS and online ordering platform for QSR chains across 120+ locations, with offline-first POS, kitchen display and multi-location sync.
- [Fitness Subscription App with Workout Tracking & Live Classes](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/fitness-wellness-subscription-app): a fitness subscription app with 80K+ subscribers and 2M+ workouts logged, featuring video streaming, workout sync and offline mode.
- [Legal Document Automation for Contract Generation & E-Signature](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/legal-document-automation-platform): a legal document automation platform for 15K+ documents a month, with contract templates, clause libraries and multi-party e-signature.
- [Manufacturing ERP for Production & Inventory](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/manufacturing-erp-system): a manufacturing ERP for 8 factories and 50K SKUs with multi-plant sync, BOM management, shop-floor data capture and 30% lower inventory.
- [Recruitment ATS for Applicant Tracking & Hiring](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/recruitment-ats-platform): a multi-tenant ATS SaaS for 200+ companies and 80K+ candidates, with resume parsing, candidate pipelines and a 65% cut in time-to-hire.
- [Event Ticketing Platform with Real-Time Availability](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/event-ticketing-platform): an event ticketing platform for 500+ events and 120K tickets, with real-time availability, scalable checkout, fraud prevention and refund workflows.
- [Real-Time Collaboration Tool for Documents & Chat](https://peregrine-it.com/case-studies/realtime-collaboration-tool): a real-time collaboration platform for 5K+ workspaces and 25K users, with presence, permissions, offline sync and sub-100ms sync latency.
